answer_1.quote: We used three LLMs, Llama 3.1 8B, Llama 3.2 3B, and Mistral 7B. We create prompts with human baselines, randomly select texts from the C4 RealNewsLike dataset, trim a fixed length of tokens as "baseline" completions from the end, and treat the remaining tokens as the prompt. Our method generates watermarked text by manipulating logits with dynamic keys.

answer_2.quote: The combination of all features achieves the best detection rate of 97.75%. The acrostic feature is associated with the smallest increase in perplexity (+0.85). Lower Z-Score indicates improved detectability.
